messages:
Nina Li: Nightly DAST (run 3509876543) flagged an auth-bypass on /internal/admin — marking here because it looks repeaty. logs attached in the run but :eyes: can someone triage? cc @sec-oncall
security-bot: DAST run completed: id=3509876543 status=failed findings=1 link=https://ci.redwood/scan/3509876543
Samir K: On it. can someone paste the raw request/response? want to see headers and cookie values
Priya (AppSec): preliminary look — pattern matches previous fp from Jan where staging auth token had expired and fallback granted limited access. please attach evidence bundle (request, response, app logs, vault/logs). add `suppress:temporary` if confirmed FP
Ben SRE: FYI we rotated the scanner service account last week and gave it `viewer` not `scanner` role in staging by mistake. that likely caused 401->fallback behavior. I'll check audit logs
Alex M (DevEx): To collect everything run:
```
./tools/dast/collect_evidence.sh --run 3509876543 --out evidence-3509876543.tar.gz
# includes: raw-reqs.json, raw-resps.json, app.log (tail 10k), vault-audit.log
```
Priya (AppSec): Also include KMS logs — the stack shows "kms:Decrypt denied" from service-scanner@staging which caused token refresh to fallback to legacy cookie. Need a KMS audit entry before we close
Ben SRE: Found audit: 2026-03-21T02:58:12Z principal=scanner-sa@staging action=iam:PassRole result=Denied reason="missing role/allow-scanner"
Samir K: Ok that explains failover. I'll pull evidence bundle and confirm if the page is actually exploitable or just degraded auth path
Priya (AppSec): If FP, we do: 1) label finding `sdlc:suppressed:ttl=7d` 2) add owner and link to evidence 3) open follow-up ticket for RBAC fix and KMS policy change 4) close after 1 security review signoff
Nina Li: Can someone open the suppression PR? need small template in repo `security/suppressions/` with fields owner, expiry, justification, evidence_link
Samir K: I'll open PR in 10m. PR msg: "temp suppress dast/3509876543 — staging token rotation induced fallback; evidence attached; owner @SamirK; expires 7d"
security-bot: New suppression PR created: https://git.redwood/security/pulls/4621 by SamirK
Priya (AppSec): Also filing a compliance note for KMS usage — tagging @compliance for audit trail. action: request KMS grant for scanner-sa with explicit decrypt on key `staging-scanner-key` and doc the change in keystore ACLs
Ben SRE: I'll patch role asap and add a TrustBound policy. Will post audit entry when complete
Alex M (DevEx): Quick checklist for merging suppression PR: 1) evidence tar uploaded to artifacts 2) PR includes `repro_steps.md` 3) AppSec signoff in review 4) link to RBAC follow-up ticket
Samir K: Evidence uploaded: https://artifacts.redwood/evidence/3509876543/evidence-3509876543.tar.gz
Priya (AppSec): Reviewed evidence, FP confirmed. leaving review comment and approving PR. Please make follow-up ticket for the RBAC/KMS fix (assign Ben)
Ben SRE: RBAC fix deployed to staging 2026-03-21T03:40Z. Audit log: https://audit.redwood/entries/987654321
Nina Li: Great. closing thread once PR merges and follow-up ticket created
Samir K: PR merged 3509876543-suppress (ttl=7d). follow-up ticket created: https://tickets.redwood/ISSUE-1428 assigned to Ben
Priya (AppSec): Note for postmortem: update DAST runbook with checklist to verify scanner SA KMS decrypt perms before nightly run. I'll add a step
Nina Li: thanks everyone :thumbsup:
